title: An unreadable Codex account setting offers no standalone way back
outcome: When TermAl cannot read termal.codex-account.json at boot, the user can still return to standalone Codex sign-in instead of being forced through /login.
acceptance: With an unreadable account setting at boot, the account view offers the standalone way back and Use standalone succeeds, clearing the managed profile sign-ins, shown by a behaviour test.
A readable setting keeps its current behaviour.
